AAP Announces 40 Candidates for 2027 Punjab Election, Two MLAs Resign

AAP released its first list of candidates for the 2027 Punjab elections, naming 40 sitting MLAs, including Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann who will contest again from Dhuri and jailed minister Arora from Ludhiana West. At the same time, two AAP MLAs quit the party. A separate report noted a murder in Mansa that could affect AAP's political standing.
